spec_features.spec_quote: An early-stop: if the deterministic detectors already register a high-confidence spiral AND ≥ min_steps_for_stop (default 10) have elapsed, we can stop early
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:177-187 checks `hc.early_stop and early_stop_scorer is not None and (step_idx+1) >= hc.early_stop_min_steps`, computes `d1 = early_stop_scorer(transcript)` and if `d1 >= hc.early_stop_d1` sets termination='early_stop' and breaks. Scorer wired in cli.py:60-63 as `detect_all(t, cfg.scoring).D1`. Both conditions (min steps AND confidence) are actually checked and the break executes.
spec_features.notes: Only active when cfg.harness.early_stop=True (default False in config.py:67; enabled only in configs/regression.yaml:26). When enabled it is fully enforced. early_stop_min_steps default 10 (config.py:68), early_stop_d1 default 0.6 (config.py:69).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Early stop on confident degradation (cost saver).

spec_features.spec_quote: End when any of: finish called, max_steps reached, or early-stop fires
spec_features.evidence: All three terminate the loop: finish -> break with termination='finish' (runner.py ~150-167); early_stop -> break with termination='early_stop' (runner.py:185-187); loop is `for step_idx in range(max_steps)` (runner.py:111) and after the loop `if not transcript.termination: transcript.termination='max_steps'` (runner.py:191-192).
spec_features.notes: All three end the episode as claimed.

spec_features.spec_quote: finish(summary) — agent declares it is done/giving up; ends the episode
spec_features.evidence: Parser accepts 'finish' (protocol.py VALID_TOOLS); runner.py dispatches `tool_env.dispatch('finish', ...)`, sets transcript.finished=True, termination='finish', and `break`s out of the loop (runner.py ~150-167). Handler _t_finish exists in tools.py:138-142 returning 'Session ended.'
spec_features.notes: Agent-initiated exit is genuinely honored as a stop. The 'giving up' framing is only in the prompt text (protocol.py TOOLS_DOC), but the mechanism does end the episode regardless of reason.

spec_features.spec_quote: We pick a default of 14 steps
spec_features.evidence: config.py:57 `max_steps: int = 14`; runner.py:69 `max_steps = task.max_steps or hc.max_steps`; runner.py:111 `for step_idx in range(max_steps)` bounds the loop and after it termination='max_steps' (runner.py:191-192). All task.yaml set max_steps:14.
spec_features.notes: The cap is read and actually bounds iteration end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_steps: int = 14 (step budget); ablations.py:7 'step budget: max_steps in {8, 14, 20}'
